summary: Lofgren has called Gaza a humanitarian catastrophe, blamed Netanyahu for famine, and urged a permanent ceasefire since 2023. She sponsors humanitarian-aid, UNRWA-restoration, and Block the Bombs legislation. But she voted yes on $14 billion in weapons to Israel, the 2024 NDAA bundling military aid, an IHRA-based resolution, and a measure condemning from the river to the sea. She has not sponsored genocide or Nakba recognition. CAIR Action rates her preferred; Vote for Peace rates her an Ally.
